label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 50
title: Operator UI: manage tiers/entitlements/subscriptions data (list/edit)
body:
## Original (as captured)
View/edit tiers, entitlements, subscriptions and tenant records in the operator console.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0060)
Define and own the license/subscription/tenant stores (single writer module; register in store-registry): tiers, entitlements (feature groups G1-G10), seats, per-tier project create/run concurrency + total quotas, trial flag, validity window, status (active/trial/expired/suspended).
